summary: The brainstorm's architecture (BaseAuthBackend subclass, py_webauthn, Redis single-use challenges, verification through POST /api/v1/login with X-Auth-Method) is confirmed by the code. Six contract errors in the skeleton were found and corrected; credential storage and migration follow the existing IdentityStore precedent. Per-tenant RP ID (user decision) introduces a new pre-auth RP resolver, which keeps overall confidence at medium.

Fallback login loop aborts on non-Auth exceptions; get_payload must fail fast with InvalidAuth
Protected handlers gate on request.get('authenticated') and use request.user.user_id
User PK is int user_id in AUTH_DB_SCHEMA

hypotheses.statement: PasskeyAuth(BasicAuth) + CredentialStore + per-origin RP resolver + is_active check in open_session delivers C1-C6 with no change to api_login

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization is high-confidence and all material unknowns are answered; the per-tenant RP resolver is new design that belongs in spec §2.
